sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that defeat, Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games and a strong record of seven wins and one draw alongside their two losses. Alsager are bottom of the table with just four points and have won only once in their last five outings, making this a favorable matchup for the hosts.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face Dawley Town away on Saturday at 15:00 in a direct test of their title credentials, with Stafford chasing the leaders on 20 points. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall (sixth, 18 points) in what could be a pivotal encounter for both sides' top-four ambitions. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community as they look to maintain recent good form. In-form Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) visit Foley Meir at home on Saturday. Mid-table Barnton host Shawbury United, who sit 15th with just one win in their last six matches. Market Drayton Town, struggling in 10th, travel to face New Mills, while Brereton Social play Widnes Town at home—the division's bottom side with only two points. Cheadle Heath Nomads, 17th, visit Telford Town (18th, 6 points), and Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two teams in the lower half of the table.
